description:
Mark Nestor property services are delighted to present to the letting market this one of a kind quaint detached bungalow in Brideswell, a quiet village located approximately 10-15 from Athlone town and has easy access to the M6 Motorway. 

Brideswell has a local national school, shop, community facilities and walking routes, while Athlone provides a much wider range of shopping, restaurants, schools, employment opportunities and transport options.

The home sits on a lovely landscaped site with ample parking and mature trees to the rear offering privacy. 

Internally, there is a large kitchen, separate living room, utility, bathroom and three double bedrooms
